title: Cour de Cassation upholds sale of the former préfecture of Marbre to a private fonds
content: The civil chamber of the Cour de Cassation has rejected the *pourvoi* of the département de Marbre against the sale of its former préfecture to a private investment fonds, closing a dispute that had bounced between the administrative and judicial orders for four years.

The building, sold in 2023 for 42 million livres, had been at the centre of a *conflit de compétence*: the Conseil d’État had held that the sale of a *domaine public* building required a prior *déclassement*, while the tribunal judiciaire found the déclassement valid. The Cassation confirms the latter reading and orders the département to pay costs.

Opposition councillors in Marbre denounced a “bradage du patrimoine” and announced a *recours* before the Cour européenne. The fonds, which has not commented, is expected to convert the building into *bureaux* and a private members’ club by 2028.
author: Marc-Antoine Rivière, rédacteur économique — Agence Continentale
